Chapter 5 · The safe window

Engineer the ascent ✓ COMPLETE

R2 / DIAGNOSTICS“New rule from the crane crew: arrive within 5.00 s or don’t bother. The cable and motor limits still apply. I have opinions about all three.”

You can now set any acceleration. The lift still speeds up for 6 m and brakes for 6 m. A program is accepted only when all three are true:

  • It arrives in time: t ≤ 5.00 s
  • The cable is safe: T < 7,200 N (exactly 7,200 N fails)
  • The motor can do it: a ≤ 2.50 m/s²
Velocity–time graph: the lift speeds up, then brakes. The area under the graph is always the 12 m trip. Dashed line: the crane leaves at 5.00 s.
